# Dated third-party audits

Material in this directory is a snapshot of external projects/reviews at the time it was captured. External repositories evolve and these files are not current implementation truth for `ai-odoo-assistant`.

Before using an external pattern:

1. inspect current `main` and identify the concrete project problem;
2. re-check the upstream public source/version/date;
3. take the specific useful contract/pattern, not its deployment by default;
4. preserve CPX host authority and embedded-runtime invariants;
5. record the current external reference in the new design/ADR when material.

The Project Atlas/Benchmark PDFs are also dated references and explicitly require revalidation against current `main`.
